units.source_text: 虽然还只是十月，山水可也冰凉了。

en.t: Although it was only October, the mountain water was already icy cold.

units.source_text: 杉圆木在一条人工挖的水沟里漂浮着，水沟的一头有个简单的炉灶，热水可能就是从那里流下来的，冒起了腾腾的热气。

en.t: Cedar logs floated in a man-made water channel, and at one end of the channel there was a simple stove; the hot water must have flowed down from there, sending up clouds of steam.
